measurement_limits: One i9-13900K / RTX 4090 host; 2D finite LineStrings and points only.
All-match pair multiset must match exactly; distance tolerance 1e-6 m plus rtol 1e-10; observed successful MA/E15 distance errors zero.
Retained bytes exclude input, construction scratch and query output.
First-process records retained separately; published medians exclude them. E15 backends share one sequential process.
No claim of arbitrary GEOS numerical robustness or universal optimality.
Public API integration, precision proof/refinement and full compatibility remain production graduation work.
